Measure → Fit ring → Design → Slice

Presets are starting dimensions with elliptical cavities. Test the 5 mm fit ring on the actual object, then adjust fit. A half sleeve exports one 180° shell; a whole sleeve exports 360°. Inspect the model in your slicer and choose settings for your printer and material. See the Guide for details.
